topic: Persistent memory layer implementation — structured JSON store with memory_search
insight: The knowledge-gate plugin provides memory_search tool (tag/topic/limit query) and systemTransform hooks for injecting context at dispatch time. Memory entries are JSON files in knowledge/memory/ with schema: id, source_kd, tags, topic, insight, created, session, version. The protocol-gate can import and call searchMemory before dispatching agents to inject relevant prior insights into dispatch prompts.
